purpose: Explicit scientific source locators: immutable Git blobs plus exact small supplements. Source IDs do not recreate legacy filesystem paths.
git_representation: bytes and sha256 describe Git blob bytes. retained_sha256/retained_bytes describe the former local representation; line_endings_only is explicit and is not a byte-equality claim. Changed scientific text is an exact_supplement rather than an old Git replacement.
scope: Source coverage and byte binding only, not scientific validation or complete data/environment reproducibility. Protected payloads were not read; data archives remain local.
